newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand okays 20.8 bln baht PTT 1997 investment.
newsitem.headline: Thailand okays 20.8 bln baht PTT 1997 investment.

text.p: Thailand's economic ministers on Monday approved Petroleum Authority of Thailand's (PTT) investment budget for 1997 of 20.80 billion baht, a government official said.
Of the total, 10.3 billion baht was for operations and 10.5 billion baht was earmarked for project investment, the official said.
The government cut the proposed investment in small unit pipelaying to 48 million baht from the proposed 300 million baht.
It also asked the PTT to freeze its planned investment with semi-state-owned Thaioil worth 4.5 billion baht.
On the overall budget, PTT forecast revenue of 188.64 billion baht and spending of 177.20 billion baht. Its net profit was expected to rise by 64 percent from last year.
